raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the Britannica snippet and incorrectly stated that Khufu (Meritites I’s husband) was buried in the Pyramid of Khafre. This confused Khufu with his son Khafre and contradicted the evidence already visible that Khufu’s sarcophagus is in the King’s Chamber of the Great Pyramid of Giza, leading toward the wrong burial location.
